To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of external sources of information, such as user-generated content and social media, can improve the users’ experience; 2) this improvement is possible by using the available information to augment the search and retrieval methods and to provide personalized services; 3) PHAROS is an integrated system that supports the exploitation of the external sources of information to improve the users’ interaction with audio-visual media; 4) PHAROS can be used in different contexts, such as

1) the use of external information can be used to improve the users’ experience in new media, and 2) the use of the external information is not a trivial task, but it can be done by means of a combination of technologies that can be used to support users in their interaction with online services.

the exploitation of external information, which is freely available, can improve the quality of the users' online experience, in the form of more accurate search and retrieval, or personalization of the service, in the form both of content recommendation and of the service itself.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (i) the use of external information in the context of multimedia retrieval, (ii) the use of social media to support users’ online experience in the context of audiovisual content consumption, (iii) the use of user-generated content for the purpose of multimedia retrieval and personalization, and (iv) the use of the Web of Data in multimedia retrieval and personalisation.
developing novel technologies for the exploitation of user generated content for personalization purposes.

the following questions: how can we exploit the new and available information to improve users’ experience? how can we provide a user-friendly interface to support the user in the process of finding the most suitable content? how can we support users in the process of creating new media content?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PHAROS is a system that aims to improve user satisfaction by providing them with the right information at the right time.

we aim at providing a framework to support a new kind of users, who are not just passive observers, but who actively contribute to the content, and who are willing to share their personal information, in order to improve their experience.
, by combining the use of the available external information with a set of novel techniques and tools, we will be able to provide users with more accurate and effective services.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we aim at providing users with an enhanced online experience, by offering them the ability to interact with the content and the services in an effective and personalized way.

we are developing a platform that can be easily extended with new modules and that can provide a wide set of services for users, such as the possibility of creating a personal profile, searching for content, annotating it, and sharing it with friends.

PHAROS is a system for personalizing users’ experience with respect to audio-visual content, by leveraging the new and freely accessible information about users and their interaction with online services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the exploitation of external information can be used to support the personalization of online spaces, which is the ultimate goal of PHAROS.
, although the amount of available information is large, it needs to be carefully selected, pre-processed and organized in order to make it usable.

the use of external information can be very useful to improve the user experience in audiovisual online spaces, especially when it is combined with the use of traditional methods, like search, to provide a more comprehensive view of the information available.
